reason: While the molecular composition of iGlarLixi (insulin glargine 100 units/mL + lixisenatide) is supported, the claimed indication significantly broadens the permitted use in the source text. panel_findings.statement: In the LixiLan-L trial of patients insufficiently controlled on basal insulin (+ metformin ± 1 OADs), LS mean change in body weight from baseline was -0.7 ± 0.2 kg in the SOLIQUA group (n=366).
In the LixiLan-L trial, LS mean change in body weight from baseline was +0.7 ± 0.2 kg in the Insulin glargine 100 units/mL group (n=365).
In the LixiLan-L trial, the difference in body weight change between SOLIQUA and Insulin glargine had p < 0.0001.
In the SoliMix trial in patients insufficiently controlled on basal insulin + OADs after 26 weeks, change in body weight from baseline was -0.7 ± 0.2 kg in the SOLIQUA group (n=443).
In the SoliMix trial, change in body weight from baseline after 26 weeks was +1.2 ± 0.2 kg in the Premix Insulin BIAsp 30 group (n=444).
In the SoliMix trial, the difference in body weight change between SOLIQUA and Premix Insulin BIAsp 30 had p < 0.0001.

In the propensity score matching analysis (LixiLan-L and GGD2) in patients insufficiently controlled on basal insulins, mean change from baseline in body weight was -0.62 ± 0.24 kg in the SOLIQUA group (n=195).
In the propensity score matching analysis, mean change from baseline in body weight was +0.70 ± 0.24 kg in the Basal bolus therapy group (n=195).
In the propensity score matching analysis, the difference in body weight change between SOLIQUA and Basal bolus therapy had p < 0.0001.
